buff.rebirth_i.effect: When dying, recover 50% of max life and consume 1 stack.
buff.damage_immune.effect: When taking damage, reduce it to 0 and consume 1 stack.
buff.vulnerable.effect: When attacked, take 50% more damage; lose 1 stack at team turn start.
buff.fear.effect: When using an attack skill, take 1 damage per stack.
buff.taunt.effect: Enemies can only target this unit; lose 1 stack when the opposing team ends its turn.
buff.thorn.effect: When attacked, deal 1 damage to the attacker per stack.
buff.stun.effect: The next skill is prevented and you lose 1 Energy; consume 1 stack after triggering.
buff.pursuit.effect: At team turn end, deal damage equal to {power}.
buff.debuff_immunity.effect: Negate 1 debuff application and consume 1 stack.
buff.invisible.effect: Cannot be targeted while other characters are alive; lose 1 stack at the opposing team's turn end.
buff.swift.effect: At team turn start, draw 1 card owned by this character per stack.
buff.extra_power.effect: When gaining Power, gain 1 extra Power per stack.
buff.extra_survivability.effect: When gaining Survivability, gain 1 extra Survivability per stack.
buff.auto_armor.effect: After being attacked, gain 1 Block per stack.
buff.barricade.effect: At turn start, retain your Block.
buff.afterimage.effect: At turn start, Block does not disappear and this loses 1 stack.
buff.weaken.effect: Deal 25% less damage; consume 1 stack after each attack.
buff.disaster.effect: When an ally ends their turn, take 1 damage per stack and consume 1 stack.
buff.divinity.effect: Attack damage is doubled; consume 1 stack at turn start.
buff.shadow.effect: When another ally attacks, all allies gain 1 Power per stack.
buff.demon.effect: Whenever a card is Exhausted, all allies gain 1 Power per stack.
buff.void.effect: When any ally plays a Survive card, all allies gain 1 Power per stack.
buff.echo.effect: Each turn, the first 1 skill card is cast twice per stack.
buff.sanctuary.effect: Whenever a character recovers or loses life, all allies gain 1 Power per stack.
buff.extra_draw.effect: At turn start, consume 1 stack to draw 1 card.
buff.source.effect: At team turn start, gain 1 additional Energy per stack.
buff.energy_storage.effect: At turn end, lose 1 less Energy per stack.
buff.next_energy.effect: At the start of next turn, consume all stacks and gain 1 Energy per stack.
buff.exhaust_shield.effect: Whenever a card is exhausted, gain 1 Block per stack.
buff.foresight.effect: Whenever you play a skill that generates cards, draw 1 card per stack.
buff.recycling.effect: Whenever a card is exhausted, draw 1 card.
buff.no_draw.effect: Cannot draw cards; lose 1 stack at turn end.
buff.search.effect: Whenever the deck is shuffled, choose 1 card from the draw pile and add it to your hand.
buff.prediction.effect: At turn start, look at 1 card from the top of the draw pile per stack and move any number of them to the discard pile.
buff.eternal_dark.effect: At turn start, gain 1 stack of Invisible per stack.
buff.beacon.effect: When gaining Block, other allies gain 1 Block per stack.
buff.curse_power.effect: Whenever attacking, apply 1 Weaken to the target per stack.
buff.weakening_field.effect: For each stack of Weakening Field, all allies gain 4 Block whenever you apply 1 stack of Weaken.
